verdict.rationale: Serving LoRA adapters is a fair question for a local LLM runtime like Ollama, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions LoRA adapters, applying adapters to a base model, or serving several adapters efficiently. Running multiple models concurrently and hot-swapping models are different capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can efficiently serve multiple LoRA adapters on top of a base model
